description: Add Ghost ID Scanner backend endpoint and replace CONNECT section in frontend with Ghost ID Scanner card
steps: Step 1 - Backend: Add a new Flask route GET /api/ghost-scan in app.py. This endpoint must: (a) Read visitor IP using CF-Connecting-IP header first, then X-Forwarded-For, then request.remote_addr. (b) Read CF-IPCountry header for country. (c) Read User-Agent header and shorten to browser/platform format (e.g. 'Chrome / Android'). (d) Read Accept-Language header and extract primary language tag. (e) Check os.environ for VPNAPI_KEY. If present, call https://vpnapi.io/api/{ip}?key={VPNAPI_KEY} and parse security.vpn, security.proxy, security.tor from response. If any is true: vpn_status='VPN / Proxy Detected', risk_level='HIGH'. If all false: vpn_status='No VPN Detected', risk_level='LOW'. If API errors: vpn_status='Scan Failed', risk_level='UNKNOWN'. If VPNAPI_KEY env var not set: vpn_status='Basic Scan Only', risk_level='UNKNOWN'. (f) Return JSON with keys: ip, country, browser, language, vpn_status, risk_level, scan_mode ('MI NETWORK OBSERVATION'). Place this route after the /stats route and before the /admin-stats route in app.py.

Step 2 - Frontend HTML: In templates/index.html, remove the entire <section class='social-section'>...</section> block (the CONNECT section with Instagram, Telegram, WhatsApp, Lynk.id Store links). Replace it with a new section for the Ghost ID Scanner card. The new section should use class 'ghost-scanner-section' with similar width/margin pattern as social-section (width:92%, max-width:560px, margin-top:28px). Inside, create a card with terminal/cyber dashboard style showing: title 'GHOST ID SCANNER', a loading state area, scan result lines (IP ADDRESS, COUNTRY, BROWSER, LANGUAGE, VPN STATUS, RISK LEVEL, SCAN MODE), and a small privacy note at the bottom.

Step 3 - Frontend CSS: Add styles for the ghost-scanner section in static/css/components.css. Follow the existing dark theme: use var(--glass) background, var(--hud-border) borders, var(--red) accents, monospace/Rajdhani fonts for terminal feel. Add a subtle scan animation (pulsing border or scanline). Style the loading state with blinking dots. Add responsive rules in static/css/responsive.css for the ghost-scanner card (same width constraints as social-section).

Step 4 - Frontend JS: Add a new file static/js/ghost-scanner.js that: (a) On DOMContentLoaded, shows loading messages in sequence ('Scanning identity...', 'Checking VPN tunnel...', 'Analyzing fingerprint...' with ~800ms delay between each). (b) Fetches GET /api/ghost-scan. (c) On success, populates the scan result fields with response data. (d) On error, shows 'Scan Failed' message. Include this script in templates/index.html before the closing </body> tag, after analytics.js.

Step 5 - CSP Update: Update the Content-Security-Policy header in app.py's set_security_headers function to allow connect-src 'self' (it already does, so verify the /api/ghost-scan fetch will work under current CSP).
Step 6 - Requirements: Verify requests is already in requirements.txt (it is - confirmed). No changes needed.
acceptance_criteria: The CONNECT section (social-section with Instagram, Telegram, WhatsApp, Lynk.id Store) is completely removed from index.html
A new GHOST ID SCANNER section appears in its place, styled with the dark/red cyber theme
GET /api/ghost-scan endpoint returns JSON with ip, country, browser, language, vpn_status, risk_level, scan_mode
The endpoint correctly reads CF-Connecting-IP, X-Forwarded-For, or remote_addr for IP
The endpoint handles VPNAPI_KEY presence/absence and API errors gracefully
The frontend auto-fetches /api/ghost-scan on page load and displays results
Loading animation shows sequential messages before data arrives
A privacy note is displayed below the scan results
The footer remains visible below the scanner section
The TikTok Downloader functionality is not affected
The navbar, stats section, and features section are not affected
The card is responsive on mobile (follows same width pattern as other sections)
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/miitokk && python -c "import app; print('OK')" to verify no import errors
Run: docker build -t miitokk:test . to verify Docker build succeeds
Run: grep -n 'ghost-scan' app.py to confirm endpoint exists
Run: grep -n 'social-section' templates/index.html to confirm CONNECT section is removed (should return nothing)
Run: grep -n 'ghost-scanner' templates/index.html to confirm scanner section exists
findings: All verification passed. Docker build succeeds. App imports cleanly. social-section fully removed from index.html. ghost-scanner section confirmed in place. ffmpeg missing on host is expected (only in Docker container).
